title: Cumbersome
summary: CUMBERSOME, adjective 1. Troublesome; burdensome; embarrassing; vexatious; as cumbersome obedience. 2. Unwieldy; unmanageable not easily borne or managed; as a cumbersome load; a cumbersome machine.
